items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I've been told that Art Tatum was in the area... do you recall this club? [INTERVIEWEE] No, I don't remember Lovejoy's.

ctx.x: I've been told that Art Tatum was in the area and playing at a place called Lovejoy's in those late thirties and early forties; do you recall this club?
